cross-posted from: https://thelemmy.club/post/59156075
[https://thelemmy.club/post/59156075] > Here is a brief concept: It is the
federated/fediverse Web search engine (this may have been based on a older post
i made) > > But how is it federated, that part i hope i can explain it well, > >
### How It May Work: > > 1: Instead of a crawler, it uses the older method of A
Hand curated database of links and websites (By the instance mods), And no it is
not like a lemmy link aggregation community, it is designed to replace
DuckDuckGo, Google, Startpage, Kagi and more, > > 1.1: it is that the server
admins add a entry to a database with that entry having a Link and a Name and
other properties, which turns into search result, you see, and the database of
Entries federate so you have more entries > > 2: The instances federate, so you
have more possible search results > > 3: you can upvote or downvote specific
search results (so if a page was SEO spam you get less of it) > > 4: it has
integration with the rest of the fediverse > > ### A Why: > > Web Index’s, And
Crawlers, could be locked down so privacy first search engines would be locked
down and have issues > > which would cause panic, unlike social media, you
cannot easily have an alternative > > ### A Notice: > > THIS CONCEPT HAS NO AI
INVOLVED IN ITS MAKING WHATSOEVER > > > i hope you understood the concept > >
### Tags For Mastodonians: > > #technology #fediverse #foss #opensource
#freesoftware #ideas #concepts > > ### Edits To The Concept: > > 1: A Karma
System for instances that get a lot of downvotes in their links > > 2: a Vote
log seen by admins with tools to help detect vote manipulation > > 3: A Rate
limiter for downvoting and upvoting
